profile.summary: A nonprofit that runs Girls on the Run programs for girls in grades 3-8 in the Bay Area. The program uses a curriculum that includes running to build participants' social, emotional and physical skills. It serves San Francisco, Marin, San Mateo, Contra Costa and Alameda Counties.
